database.description: The database of the item to remove rendering from. Only sent when addressing by id -- a path carries its own database prefix (e.g. master:/sitecore/content/Home).

finalLayout.description: Target the final layout (default true), where list-renderings' uniqueIds live. False = shared only.

id.description: The ID of the item to remove rendering from. Supply this or path.

path.description: The path of the item to remove rendering from. Supply this or id.
